items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript describes an interview where Paul Desmond interviewed Charlie 'Bird' Parker, not Von Freeman. Von Freeman only confirms the story about Bird.

ctx.x: One is an interview where Paul Desmond is interviewing him. It’s a good interview. Paul Desmond asks him, how did you get this incredible technique and all this stuff and everything, and Bird, he said, practice.
